Run graph-based clustering on a fuzzy simplicial set graph

Source: R/umap.R
dot-run_clustering.Rd

Performs Leiden or Louvain community detection on the KNN graph. When method is NULL, Leiden is tried first with Louvain as fallback. Port of rconga's .run_clustering().

Usage

.run_clustering(knn_graph, resolution = 1, method = NULL)

Arguments

knn_graph

Sparse matrix (N x N) from .build_knn_graph().

resolution

Numeric. Resolution parameter. Default 1.0.

method

Character or NULL. "leiden", "louvain", or NULL (try Leiden first).

Value

Integer vector of length N with 0-based cluster IDs.
